messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deployment failed: 12/25 canaries in us-west-2 returning 500s for /v1/generate. Error spike started ~2m ago. Stack: inference-prod-canary-2026. Rolling back not yet triggered.
sam (oncall): seeing alerts, joining. pinging @jenna and @mike. any idea if this is infra or config?
jenna (sre): I saw the same alerts. Logs show repeated KMS decryption errors when the canary tries to load model keys: `AccessDeniedException: decrypt failed` and `InvalidCiphertextException` mixed. Could be a rotated key or missing grant.
mike (platform): we rotated the KMS key as part of key rotation last night for the prod account, but the rollout process should've added the new key to the inference role. I'll check the rollout job.
tara (release-engineer): this deploy included the new feature flag rollout for `ff=inference-encrypt-v2` and a small change to env var `KMS_KEY_ALIAS`. Canary config picks alias from env.
lucas (support): customers on hosted API are seeing 502 spikes, support cases coming in. Not widespread yet but some enterprise tenants in us-west-2 are affected.
sam (oncall): impact: partial, canary only but traffic routed by platform saw a few fallbacks. Are we able to kill the FF quickly? we should stop further rollout.
jenna (sre): agree. Recommend kill-switch the FF and pause the deployment. If kill-switch flips, traffic should revert to previous code path that uses the old key alias.
mike (platform): I can flip the kill-switch in the console. Doing it now: `PATCH /api/flags/inference-encrypt-v2 -> false`.
ops-bot: Feature flag `inference-encrypt-v2` set to `false` by mike (platform) at 14:12 UTC. :white_check_mark:
sam (oncall): confirm canary health after flip?
jenna (sre): still seeing KMS errors from the existing canaries for another minute — cache / process needs restart.
tara (release-engineer): I'll pause the pipeline and stop the canary group. `ci:stop canary inference-prod-canary-2026`.
jenna (sre): stopped canaries. Error rate dropped to baseline. No new 500s after stopping. Temporary mitigation worked.
mike (platform): quick root cause: the key rotation job created a new key and alias `alias/redwood/inference/v2` but forgot to attach the IAM grants to the inference instance role in the org account. Can confirm `kms:Decrypt` missing for role `arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/inference-node` on the new key.
sam (oncall): ok, plan: 1) rollback/abort deploy (already paused), 2) grant KMS decrypt to inference role for new key, 3) re-run canary with small sample, 4) if stable re-enable FF and resume rollout. Who owns step 2?
mike (platform): I'll add the grant. Applying a resource-based policy grant now: attaching via `aws kms create-grant` to the key. Command I'm running:\n\n```\naws kms create-grant --key-id <new-key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/inference-node --operations Decrypt --name canary-grant\n```\n\nI'll also update the CloudFormation canary role bindings so this doesn't regress.
jenna (sre): while you do that, can we also rotate back the alias as a fail-safe? i.e., point `alias/redwood/inference` back to the old key until postmortem complete.
mike (platform): yes we can reassign alias: `aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/inference --target-key-id <old-key-id>` — doing it as a secondary safety while grant propagates.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline paused by tara (release-engineer) at 14:13 UTC. Canary group stopped.
lucas (support): letting affected customers know: "We're temporarily rolling back a recent encryption key change and pausing the rollout. No action required on your side; we'll update when service is back to normal." Putting a status update out.
jenna (sre): I see grants created and alias moved. Canaries restarted with a single instance. Monitoring now.
sam (oncall): any immediate errors now?
jenna (sre): no KMS errors in the restarted canary logs. Latency and error rate are within baseline. Rolling out more slowly still paused.
tara (release-engineer): hold on the merge too; I reverted the pipeline commit that updated the env var `KMS_KEY_ALIAS`. New deploys blocked until postmortem.
mike (platform): long-term fix: add automated check in the rotation job to verify `kms:Decrypt` for all service roles and auto-create grants, and add an integration test in staging that simulates rotate+deploy.
sam (oncall): good. For the incident report: priority P2 (partial impact, canary/early rollback), duration ~12m from alert to mitigation. Actions: kill-switch flip, pipeline pause, grant creation, alias reassign.
lucas (support): ticket log updated and customers notified. No escalations yet.
jenna (sre): adding immediate remediation checklist to thread: 1) confirm grants for new key (mike) 2) revert alias if needed (mike) 3) restart canaries (tara) 4) monitor for 10m stable (sam) 5) postmortem and follow-up (assigned: jenna)
sam (oncall): handing off to jenna for postmortem. I'm going off-call in 10m, but will be reachable if needed. :phone:
jenna (sre): taking over. I'll collect logs, timeline, and write postmortem. Tentative RCA: missing grant in rotation job caused KMS decrypt failures in canary, caused partial customer impact via fallbacks. Next steps: add grant automation, add guardrail in release pipeline to fail deploy if `KMS_KEY_ALIAS` changed without verified grants, and improve canary health gating.
mike (platform): noted. I'll also add a runbook entry for manual alias rollback and a check in the rotation playbook.
ops-bot: Incident closed for now by jenna (sre) at 14:25 UTC — mitigation applied, monitoring stable. :lock:
sam (oncall): thx team. Jenna will own the postmortem and action items. Marking for follow-up in the eng-oncall retro.
